# Design: UserProfileCard (Primitive display)

## L1 — User intent
A user authorized as `profile:read` views their own profile card: display name, masked account number (last 4 only), masked email (first char + domain), and PDPA-flagged government_id (redacted with reveal action that emits an audit event).

Read-only. No mutations. No navigation.

## L2 — UI architecture
- **Pillar**: `Primitive` (pure presentation; no fetching, no business logic).
- **Component tree**: `UserProfileCard` -> `MaskedField` (existing primitive) x3 + `RedactedField` (existing primitive) x1.
- **State ownership**: server (data passed in as props by Feature parent — Primitive does not fetch); local (boolean `is_government_id_revealed`).
- **Rendering model**: Client Component (interactive — reveal toggles local state). Parent Page handles SSR/CSR.

## L3 — Technical strategy
- **A11y**: WCAG 2.1 AA. Reveal control is a `<button aria-pressed>`. Live region announces reveal/hide. Focus stays on the reveal button after toggle. Tab order matches visual.
- **Error / loading / empty**: data is a prop; loading/empty are parent's concern. Component asserts non-null props via TypeScript; renders empty fragment if any prop is missing (defensive — should not happen).
- **Token storage**: n/a (display-only).
- **PII**: `account_number` masked (last 4 visible); `email` masked (first char + domain); `government_id` redacted with audit-on-view reveal action. `display_name` is `none` (already a public field per design).
- **Analytics**: one event `pii.government_id.viewed` on reveal (audit-on-view requirement).
- **Tests**: component test with RTL — assert label-based queries for masked / redacted display, reveal interaction, focus retention, axe clean.

## L4 — Implementation sketch
- `src/features/profile/components/UserProfileCard.tsx`: Primitive component.
- `src/features/profile/components/UserProfileCard.types.ts`: prop types (imported from codegen User shape with parser-local narrowing).
- `src/features/profile/components/UserProfileCard.test.tsx`: component tests + axe.
